decision_conditions:
Consent is refused for the following works:
• T1 (Scotch pine) - Reduce height by approximately 6.1m and reduce crown spread by approximately 4m.

The works requested would remove over 50% of the trees. This would remove the trees apical dominance, whilst seriously prejudicing hormonal balancing and would be seriously detrimental to the trees physical health and contributions provided to the visual amenity of the locality. This would impact the trees form in the long-term and would likely lead to the increase in density of lateral growth and development, against the aims of this work in reducing encroachment and light. Considering these points, the works requested within this application would be seriously detrimental to the tree’s health and contributions to the visual amenity of the locality. On this basis, the works are refused consent.
